## 3100 - 3199

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30100">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3100 QES - Quality expert system</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30100">

This is a header exception; it is never generated within the application.

Exceptions 3100–3214 are generated for Source Validations.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 578;height: 336;" />

The only unit available for these particular validations is Standard Deviation. The user can set the Window to reflect the amount of prior samples that will be considered in creating an average that will determine the standard deviation. For example, the average Relative Density for the previous 10 records could be = 0.60 so if the current sample has a relative density higher than 1.10 or less than 0.10, an exception will be thrown.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03101">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3101 QES - High relative density</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03101">

This exception is generated when a source’s Relative Density exceeds the user defined standard deviation limit for maximum Relative Density. For example, the standard deviation limit for Relative Density is set to 0.500. The Relative Density average from the previous 10 sample records is = 0.60. If the current sample has a Relative Density of 1.11 or higher, then exception 3101 will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03102">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03102">

This exception is generated when a source’s Relative Density exceeds the user defined standard deviation limit for minimum Relative Density. For example, the standard deviation limit for Relative Density is set to 0.500. The Relative Density average from the previous 10 sample records is = 0.60. If the current sample has a Relative Density of 0.09 or lower, then exception 3102 will be generated.

</div>
